titles.title: Untitled (Tent Door at Night)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: The light-colored triangular shape of the tent door forms the central focus of this image.  The triangle is bisected by a vertical tent post.  On each side of the tent, thick brushstrokes descend from the upper edge of the work and curve slightly toward its edges.  Several other thick brushstrokes in a variety of dark colors swirl along the lower border of the painting.
